src.bungie: Powered melee final blows grant invisibility and restore a portion of health and shields. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the duration of the invisibility and the amount of health and shields restored.
src.clarity:
Powered Melee Kills and Finishers grant Invisibility and restore 67 HP.
Invisibility Duration is based on Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 7 seconds
• Elites, Enemy Players: 10 seconds
• Minibosses and Bosses: 13 seconds
The duration of Invisibility granted by Finishers is 3 seconds longer. Echo of Persistence increases Invisibility duration by 41.5%.

Grants Void Invisibility and restores 67 Health.
(Finishers) increase the duration of the Void Invisibility by +3 seconds.
Invisibility Duration 
Minor = 7 seconds (10)
Elite | Guardian = 10 seconds (13)
Miniboss+ = 13 seconds (16)

src.bungie:
Weighted Knife gains a second bounce. Rapid precision hits with your weapons grant Weighted Knife a significant damage bonus, bonus melee, and the ability to stun unshielded combatants for a short time.

Empowered Weighted Knife is strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

Requires Weighted Throwing Knife to be equipped in order to function.
Grants Weighted Throwing Knifes a second bounce with greatly increased tracking and velocity.
Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2.5 seconds of each grants the 'Strengthened Throwing Knife' buff for 10 seconds. Precision Hits extend the buff duration by 5 seconds up to the maximum of 30 seconds.
Strengthened Throwing Knife:
• Grants 50 Strength while the buff is active
• Deals 300% [100%] Increased Damage
• Stuns Unstoppable Champions
• Buff is consumed on Knife Hit

src.bungie: Your Threaded Specter has increased duration and durability, and damaging it releases additional Threadlings. While near your Threaded Specter, you do not appear on radar.

Decreases Class Ability Regeneration Speed by 50% for 19 seconds upon Class Ability usage.
Grants the following to Threaded Specters:
• 50% [25%] Damage Resistance (bypassed by damage from you)
• 34% increased duration
• 2 Perched Threadlings
Perched Threadlings are released when the Specter takes 40 damage. Destroying the Specter releases both Threadlings.
Being within 15 meters of your own Specter grants the 'Hidden' buff which removes you from enemy radar.

src.bungie: Guarding with your Arc Staff does not consume extra Super energy. [Super]  : Cancel Arc Staff early, temporarily increasing Arc weapon damage and creating a blinding burst. Reflected attacks increase the damage of the burst, extend your Super, and deal additional damage.
src.clarity:
While in Arc Staff Super:
• Blocking doesn't consume Super Energy
• Reflected projectiles deal 400% increased damage
• Reflecting projectiles refunds Super Energy
Arc Staff can be deactivated at any time to preserve a portion of unspent Super Energy: 75% refund at 100% Super Energy and linearly scaling down to a 50% refund at 0% Super Energy.
On Arc Staff deactivation:
• Triggers a Blinding explosion in a 10 meter radius around you that deals 675 to 2700 [? to ?] damage with no falloff based the the number of projectiles reflected
• Grants 4 Stacks of Arc Weapon Surge for 21 [16] seconds

Triggers an Arc Explosion, dealing scaling damage based on the amount of reflected projectiles and blinding enemies within 10 meters.

src.bungie:
Your Proximity Knife scorches targets it damages with its explosions, or ignites targets on final blow.

After throwing a Proximity Knife, you gain increased melee regeneration until the knife explodes. Gain a small amount of melee energy when your Scorch damages a target, and Ignition final blows fully refund melee energy and can overflow into an additional knife charge.
src.clarity:
Grants 625% Additional Base Melee Recharge Rate while Proximity Knife remains unexploded.
Proximity Explosive Knife applies 60 Scorch on detonation. (Unaffected by Ember of Ashes). Proximity Explosive Knife kills trigger an Ignition.
Ignition kills (on any subclass) grant a full Melee Ability Charge. This can overflow into one additional Solar Knife charge (any knife) or one additional Withering Blade charge beyond capacity.
On Prismatic, this can overflow into two additional Knife Tricks or Withering Blades beyond capacity.
Scorch grants 7% Melee Ability Energy per tick. (Due to chunk ability scaling, this grants ~5% energy to Proximity Knife).

src.bungie: Precision final blows reduce the cooldown of your Super. Modifies Golden Gun to fire a single, high-damage shot. Targets defeated by that shot give you Super energy and explode.

The triggered Ignition overrides base Scorch sources and solely benefits from damage increases to the Golden Gun.
(A Celestial Nighthawk Precision Hit is ~85% more damage compared to 3 Precision Hits with Marksman Golden Gun. Also, please only use it with Marksman Golden Gun in PvE)

src.bungie: Damaging a powerful combatant or Guardian with an ability temporarily increases weapon damage of the same type. Defeating that marked target with damage that matches the element creates an Elemental pickup.
src.clarity:
Dealing ability damage to unhighlighted Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Player targets highlights them for 10 seconds and grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for 16 [11] seconds.
Highlight duration is not refreshable.
Killing highlighted targets with weapons matching the element of the highlighting ability spawns an Elemental Pickup corresponding to the element in question.
Elemental Pickups include Firesprites, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, Tangles, and Void Breaches.

Upon dealing Ability Damage to an Elite, Miniboss, Champion, Boss, or Guardian: 
Grants x4 Ability Element-Matching Weapon Surge and highlights the enemy for 16 [11] seconds.
Buff is not refreshable.
Killing highlighted enemies spawns a Subclass-Matching Elemental Pickup.

src.bungie:
After landing a final blow while at full health, or when out of combat for an extended duration, your shields will slowly recharge into an overshield. 

When you have an overshield, your weapons gain increased accuracy, stability, handling, and damage against combatants, and final blows will grant a short period of increased mobility once the overshield is depleted.
src.clarity:
While at Full HP, scoring a Weapon Kill or not taking damage for 4.5 [15] seconds continuously generates 6.6 [1.1] Void Overshield HP per second until you take damage again.
Grants the following while any Overshield is active:
• 15% increased weapon damage against Combatants (20% for Heat-Based weapons)
• 25 Stability
• 25 Handling
• 5% Decreased Accuracy Cone Size
Damage bonus stacks with other Empowering weapon buffs.
While any Overshield is active, scoring a kill enables 'Hasty Escape'. Hasty Escape activates upon the depletion of your Overshield, granting 30 Mobility for 5 seconds.

src.bungie:
Increases grenade, melee, and dodge regeneration while sprinting.

Gain stacks of Frost Armor while sprinting. When you have Frost Armor, Stasis weapons deal additional damage.

src.bungie: Activating Ascension or Tempest Strike throws bouncing explosives at nearby targets that jolt and damage them. Jolting nearby targets grants you damage resistance.

Casting Ascension or Tempest Strike releases 3 tracking Arc Projectiles that each deal up to 200 [40] Arc damage and apply Jolt on Hit.
Applying Jolt to enemies within 15? meters grants you a Damage Resist buff for 10 seconds that can stack 3 times.

25% [5%] | 40% [7.5%] | 50% [10%]

Grants a stack of Resist for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 4 stacks.

Receiving Melee damage or scoring an Arc Elemental Melee Hit grants the 'Cross Counter' buff for your next Melee Attack within 3 seconds.

src.bungie: Improves sprint, slide, and airborne effectiveness while a Hand Cannon is equipped. For a short time after being drawn, Hand Cannons ready faster, are more accurate, and each hit against a combatant increases Hand Cannon damage.
src.clarity:
Passively grants the following benefits while a Hand Cannon is readied:
• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance
Readying a Hand Cannon grants 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 6 seconds (for the PVE-only benefits of the perk, consider this the 0th Stack).

• 100 Ready Speed Handling
• 0.6x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size

• Sturm's Overcharged Rounds only receive 11% increased damage per Stack (110%).
• Hawkmoon's Paracausal Shot receives 5% increased damage per stack upon being fired (50%).
• Malfeasance's Explosive Shadow is unaffected by the buff.
While at 'Illegally Modded Holster x7' or higher:
Swapping to a non-Hand Cannon weapon or the buff expiring grants you the 'Out of Luck' debuff. 'Out of Luck' prevents you from reacquiring 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 10 seconds.

src.bungie: While you have a Stasis or Arc Super equipped, your Dodge becomes a longer range, faster moving shift that partially cloaks you during use. After shifting, your Stasis and Arc weapons gain a stacking damage bonus for a short time. Final blows with this bonus active refund class ability energy.

Shift effectively acts as a fast horizontal teleport with a travel distance of 10 meters. Shift renders you completely invisible (except for a trail) and invulnerable for the duration of the animation.
Casting Shift grants one stack of 'Light Shift' for 11 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.
Light Shift grants 10%|21%|33% increased Arc, Stasis, and Lord of Wolves Weapon Damage at 1|2|3 Stacks.
Light Shift additionally grants 10% increased Weapon Damage against Stasis-debuffed enemies.
Light Shift's buff stacks with all other buff sources.
Passive Class Ability regeneration is disabled for the duration of Light Shift. Instead, Weapon Kills grant 60% Class Ability Energy while Light Shift is active.

src.bungie: Threaded Spike can bounce to Tangles, detonating them and returning immediately. Tangles detonated by Threaded Spike are rewoven and retrieved by it. Catches without a Tangle refund extra melee energy.
src.clarity:
Threaded Spike can now target and bounce to Tangles, detonating them on impact and immediately returning to the user.
Catching the Threaded Spike after it detonates a Tangle equips you with a second throwable Tangle. Alternatively, failing to catch the Threaded Spike triggers a 9 meter Strand Detonation around you, dealing 727 [?] damage with no falloff.
This detonation counts as Powered Melee damage, scaling with the Melee stat and triggering melee-effects.
Catching a Threaded Spike that didn't detonate a Tangle refunds an additional fixed 25% Melee Ability Energy.

src.bungie:
Defeat targets to charge up cages of loyal moths that fly toward nearby targets or allies.
 
[Grenade]  : Throw the cage of loyal moths, which are released on impact. Upon reaching targets, moths detonate in a blinding explosion; upon reaching allies, moths provide a Void overshield.
src.clarity:
Kills charge up 'Winged Eclipse', with progress granted based on Enemy Rank.
• Minor Enemies: 1
• Elite Enemies: 2
• Miniboss+ and Guardians: 3
At six charges, replaces your grenade abilty with two charges of Loyal Moths. Incurs a six second cooldown upon spending both charges before progress can be gained.
Moth Grenades explode on impact, releasing 2 Loyal Moths that fly to their nearest target. Moths that spawn closer to allies turn into Void Moths, while Moths that spawn closer to enemies turn into Arc Moths.
Loyal Moth variants:
• Arc Moths: slower-flying, offensive role. They seek out targets at 10m/s and detonate on contact, dealing up to 526 [31 to Players, 201 to Objects] damage in a 4 meter radius and Blinding targets. Counts as Arc Grenade Damage.
• Void Moths: faster-flying, support role. They seek out allies at 25m/s and grant them a 22.5 HP Void Overshield on contact.
src.compendium:
Kills grant charges of Winged Eclipse Ready, up to a maximum of 6.
Rank-and-File = 1 | Elite = 2 | Miniboss+ and Guardians = 3
When fully charged, grants 2 Grenade Charges of Winged Eclipse.
Incurs a 6 second cooldown upon throwing the last moth cage before Winged Eclipse can be charged.
Winged Eclipse:
Releases 2 Moths on impact. Moth Element changes depending on the closest 2 targets within 20 meters.
If there are no targets within 20 meters, they default to Void Moths.
Releases an Arc Moth if the closest target is an enemy, pursuing at ~10m/s and detonating on contact.
Arc Moths deal up to 473 [31 Guardians | 201 Constructs] Arc Grenade Damage and blind over a 4 meter radius.
Releases a Void Moth if the closest target is an allied Guardian.
Void Moths chase their allies at ~25m/s, bestowing 22.5 Void Overshield HP on contact.

src.bungie: Bow perfect draw can be held indefinitely. Gain a bonus to the Bow's damage when released, based on how long perfect draw was held. Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of Bows.
src.clarity:

Full Draws grant 'Adamantine Brace':
• Allows Perfect Draws to be held indefinitely
• Grants 37.5% increased damage against PVE Combatants for every 0.5 seconds you hold a perfect draw, up to a 200% increase
PVE damage buff only affects the initial Impact damage (e.g. Wish Ender's overpenetration is unaffected) and expires after 4 seconds of Adamantine Brace being active.
Leviathan's Breath does not receive the damage increase.
src.compendium:
Passively grants +40 Airborne Effectiveness and +10 Draw Time to Bows.
+10 Draw Time is equivalent to Draw Time Masterwork.
Bows can hold perfect draws indefinitely.
After 0.35 seconds of reaching full draw on a Primary Ammo Bow:
Grants increased damage every 0.5 seconds, up to 200% increased impact damage against Combatants after 2 seconds.
Broadhead, Poison, Stasis Crystals, Dragonfly/Explosive Head, and others are not affected.
Damage Buff disappears after holding full draw for 4 seconds.
